### About

Hi everyone, I'm Yuhan! I’m a healthcare data and biostatistics professional with experience across pharmaceuticals, healthcare consulting, academia, and health policy. My work includes clinical trial and real-world evidence analyses, with a focus on survival analysis and statistical programming in R and SAS, to support decision-making in life sciences and healthcare.

Outside of work and academics, I enjoy walking in nature, listening to music, and rewatching episodes of *Friends*.
